description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**可能不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** value as the **ClientToken** value. The **RequestId** value may be different for each API request.

description.zh:
QoS策略的描述信息。

长度为0～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en:
The description of the QoS policy.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
QoS策略的名称。

长度为0～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en:
The name of the QoS policy.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
QoS策略所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the QoS policy.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

description.zh:
资源的标签键。至少输入 1 个标签键，最多支持输入 20 个标签键。如需传入该值，不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持 128 个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en:
The tag key of the resource. You must specify at least 1 tag key and can specify at most 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with aliyun or acs:, or contain http:// or https://.

description.zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入 20 个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持 128 个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify at most 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with aliyun or acs:, or contain http:// or https://.

title.en: Create an express connect qoS policy

descriptions.zh:
- 当前高速通道QoS功能处于邀测状态，调用本接口需要先联系商务经理开通白名单

- 每个用户能够创建的QoS策略数量有配额限制，如果需要扩充配额，请联系商务经理
descriptions.en:
- The Express Connect QoS feature is currently in invitational preview. To call this operation, contact your account manager to be added to the whitelist.

- The number of QoS policies that each user can create is subject to a quota limit. To increase the quota, contact your account manager.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc create-express-connect-traffic-qos --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --qos-name qos-test --qos-description qos-test --resource-group-id rg-acfmxazfdgdg0000 --tags Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc CreateExpressConnectTrafficQos --region cn-hangzhou --Tags.1.Value FinanceJoshua --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxazfdgdg0000' --Tags.1.Key FinanceDept --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --QosName 'qos-test' --QosDescription 'qos-test'
